description:
If \(T\supseteq Q\) is consistent and its axiom codes are computably enumerable, its specified Rosser sentence \(R_T\) satisfies both \(T
vdash R_T\) and \(T
vdash
eg R_T\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.FirstIncompleteness.first_incompleteness
  (T : Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Theory) (hQ : Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.Q ⊆ T)
  (he :
    Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.CodeEnumerable
      Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.arithmeticSignature T)
  (hcon : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Consistent T) :
  ¬Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Derives T
        (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.FirstIncompleteness.rosserSentence
          (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.FirstIncompleteness.proofRepresentation T he)) ∧
    ¬Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Derives T
        (FirstOrder.Language.Formula.not
          (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.FirstIncompleteness.rosserSentence
            (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.FirstIncompleteness.proofRepresentation T he)))
